name: Public portfolio shows all main sections
covers: hero, stats, services, about and footer rendering
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor sees the full portfolio built from default content.
steps: Open the site root without signing in
Look at the hero area, the stats row and the Services offered section
Scroll to the About section and the footer
expected: The name 'Your Name' is shown as the main heading, three stats such as '5+' are visible, seven numbered services (01. to 07.), each with a preview graphic, are shown, an About section and a footer with phone and email are visible.

name: Projects section shows eight clickable project cards
covers: project card links opening in a new tab
description: Verifies the Selected projects section lists the eight live projects and each links out to its site.
steps: Open the site root without signing in
Look at the project cards and their titles
expected: Eight project cards are visible including RentFlow, KGGA LMS, MalariaWatch Kenya, Braidy's Website, Braidy's SMS, Prints of Africa, SafiGroom OS and AmaniCode Solutions, each with a preview area and a title link that opens its project site in a new tab.

name: Mobile menu navigates to the contact call-to-action
description: Verifies the mobile hamburger menu opens and the Contact me link scrolls to the booking section.
steps: Open the site root on a mobile viewport
expected: The menu closes and the 'Have a project or role in mind?' section with a 'Get in touch' button is visible on screen.

name: Admin page requires a password
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor cannot see the editor and is asked for the admin password.
steps: Open the site root and then navigate to the #/admin address
expected: A 'Site admin' screen with an admin password field and a 'Sign in to manage your site' button is shown, and no editing fields or Save changes button are visible.
